recognize_zh: EBER 原位雜交：積液細胞塊中約一半的大型腫瘤細胞核呈棕色陽性訊號，其餘細胞核為藍色（陰性）；PEL 多數同時帶有 HHV8 與 EBV（尤其 HIV 病人），EBER 陽性支持診斷但 HHV8 才是必要條件。
features: Nuclear brown EBER signal in roughly half of the large atypical cells
Variable signal intensity from strong to weak among positive nuclei
Negative cells show blue hematoxylin counterstained nuclei
Positive cells are large, discohesive and arranged in a loose cluster
Clean background without non-specific cytoplasmic staining
describe_en: In situ hybridization for EBV-encoded small RNA (EBER) on the effusion cell block shows nuclear positivity in a substantial subset, approximately half, of the large atypical lymphoid cells, with variable signal intensity; the remaining cells are negative. There is no non-specific background staining. Most primary effusion lymphomas, particularly in HIV-positive patients, are dually infected by KSHV/HHV8 and EBV. The findings support the diagnosis of EBV-positive primary effusion lymphoma, provided HHV8 LANA-1 positivity is also demonstrated.

ddx.vs: Fibrin-associated DLBCL is also EBER positive but is HHV8 LANA-1 negative, expresses B-cell markers and arises in chronic fibrin deposits.
EBV+ DLBCL forms tissue masses, expresses CD20/PAX5 and lacks HHV8, unlike the effusion-based HHV8+ null-phenotype PEL.

ddx.dx: Pyothorax-associated lymphoma (DLBCL associated with chronic inflammation)
ddx.vs: It arises after long-standing pyothorax as a pleural mass, is EBV+ B-cell lineage and HHV8 negative.
